The '''Noral Sea''' was a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="OaAI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Noral Sea was mentioned in ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', a [[2014]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="OaAI" />
